title: videóhívás, kamera, hang: A Video Call

sections.title: Words for a video call
sections.content: A *videóhívás* is a video call. On one you check two things first: the picture, which needs the *kamera*, and the *hang* ("sound, voice"). *kamera* is a borrowed word and takes ordinary endings, such as *a kamerát* for the object. You know *hívás* ("call") from Unit 31. A call can also end badly: *megszakad* ("to be cut off, to break off") is another verb that simply happens, like *lefagy*: *Megszakadt a hívás.*

sections.title: Key phrases
rows: There is a video call on Sunday.

items.spanish: Jó a kamera, de nincs hang.
items.english: The camera is good, but there is no sound.

items.spanish: Kapcsold be a kamerát, nem látlak!
items.english: Switch the camera on, I can't see you!
Suddenly the video call was cut off.

sections.content: *hang* means both "sound" and "voice". When a call has no sound at all, say *Nincs hang*. For a person's voice you say *a hangod* ("your voice"): *Jó a hangod* means "Your voice is good".
